exposure: AFI of or less than 5cm at term
amniotic fluid index (AFI) of 5cm or less
cohort: 100 pregnant women diagnosed with oligohydramnios at term (AFI ≤ 5 cm) and 300 pregnant women with normal AFI at term (AFI > 8 cm)
finding: Oligohydramnios is associated with a high rate of pregnancy complications and increased perinatal morbidity and mortality, particularly low birth weight.
mod_finding: Oligohydramnios was associated with an increased incidence of cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in the oligohydramnios group
